content:
“Meet a new type of supercharged Ghoul with electrifying weapons and armor and expose their origin.”— *Journey to Skyline Valley* on Bethesda.net

**The Lost** are creatures found in Appalachia in *Fallout 76*, introduced in the *Skyline Valley* update.

The Lost were created when the Ghouls of Vault 63 sought to use their meteorological technology to avoid the chance of going feral. All Lost wear burned variants of Vault 63 equipment.

- Always found at Research Site Rhineland.
- Can be found around Dark Hollow Manor.

The Lost appear in *Fallout 76*, introduced in the *Skyline Valley* update.
